title: Template:WeeklyTokens
text: The weekly Activity Token quests as three boxes (Friday, Saturday, Sunday) with the quest names and the tokens each one gives. Each day lasts from 00:00 to 23:59 server time (New York). The day that is active is highlighted and the boxes count down to the next day. Usage {{WeeklyTokens}} A small version for the hero of the Main Page (always dark, no explanations): {{WeeklyTokens|mini=yes}} The quests and tokens are in Module:WeeklyTokens (the list DAYS at the top). Change them there. The highlight and the countdown come from the script in MediaWiki:Common.js (the World Events block). Without it the boxes are a plain list. On the Main Page the small version sits in the hero (Template:Tl); Template:Tl is the large version as a section. The token icon is File:Activity Token.png.

Usage

A small version for the hero of the Main Page (always dark, no explanations):

  • On the Main Page the small version sits in the hero (Template:Tl); Template:Tl is the large version as a section.
  • The token icon is File:Activity Token.png.
